quarterly_data.quarter: Focuslight Technologies half-year report: 2026 Half-Year Report (08-08-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: H1 2026 results (half-year report): revenue RMB 418.57 million, up 6.57% YoY; net loss attributable RMB 67.23 million, a wider loss on asset impairments (including goodwill impairment of RMB 3,100.16 ten-thousand on the automotive business), higher finance costs and share-based pay. Optical communications revenue RMB 6,688.07 ten-thousand, up 214.89% on growing pluggable transceiver demand; pan-semiconductor RMB 11,091.07 ten-thousand (+18.04%); industrial RMB 10,651.13 ten-thousand (-16.65%); automotive RMB 5,586.18 ten-thousand (-18.88%).
quarterly_data.figure: H1 revenue RMB 418.57 million (+6.57%); optical communications RMB 6,688.07 ten-thousand (+214.89%)

quarterly_data.quarter: Focuslight Technologies half-year report: 2026 Half-Year Report (08-08-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Optical communications progress (half-year report): micro-optics for pluggable transceivers are in volume supply at some customers; NPO/CPO micro-optics and high-channel V-groove products (36 channels and above) added multiple customers in H1 2026, some customers completed volume validation and moved to batch delivery, and orders on hand keep increasing; for micro-prism lens arrays the company signed a technology licensing agreement with one core customer and is executing it, with a pilot line under construction; precision molded lenses passed sample validation at several customers and batch orders are landing. The company is expanding optical-communications capacity and planning V-groove mass-production capacity on customers' volume forecasts.
quarterly_data.figure: V-groove 36 channels and above in batch delivery; MPLA technology licensing agreement signed

quarterly_data.quarter: Focuslight Technologies half-year report: 2026 Half-Year Report (08-08-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Company (half-year report): a new project on AlN laser substrate materials for silicon-photonics module CW light sources and CPO external laser sources is in sampling and customer validation with several leading industry customers; the company also provides chip-on-submount (COS) packaging foundry services for optical chips to some customers.

quarterly_data.quarter: Focuslight Technologies half-year report: 2026 Half-Year Report (08-08-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Automotive (half-year report): all previously disclosed lidar design-win projects have been cancelled and no new business is expected near term; an overseas projection-lighting customer has placed no new pull orders; the company is shifting resources to optical communications and consumer electronics.
